posts.title: How to save an article without ads as a PDF
posts.metaTitle: Save an article without ads as a PDF
posts.metaDescription: Save a clean article as a PDF. Free, no signup, and no watermark. Learn how pasted URLs are processed before you use the cleaner.
posts.primaryKeyword: how to save an article without ads
secondaryKeywords: save a clean webpage as PDF
remove clutter before printing a webpage
posts.answer: To save an article without ads, open PrintxPDF Web Page Cleaner, paste a public URL, and review the cleaned page. Then print it or save it as a PDF from your browser. Cleanup runs in your tab after the page loads. PrintxPDF first tries its own reader for the URL; if that fails or stalls, the URL may be sent to public reader services. For a private page, paste the content or open a local file instead.

body.x: To save an article without ads, use [Web Page Cleaner](/print) to remove menus and page clutter, then print the clean view or save it as a PDF. Keep the original URL and check that the article is complete before you archive or share the copy.
How to save an article without ads

items.x: Visit [PrintxPDF Web Page Cleaner](/print) in your browser. You do not need an account.
Paste a public URL. If the site blocks readers, paste the HTML or text, or open a supported local file.
Check the title, article text, important links, and images. Dynamic pages or pages behind a login may not load fully.
Use your browser’s Print option and choose Save as PDF. Adjust paper size and margins if needed.
Check page breaks, clipped content, and small text. Keep the source URL and access date with the file.

body.x: Clean and print a web page. Free, no signup, no watermark.
What happens to the URL you paste?

The cleanup and reading view run in your browser tab after the page is fetched. To retrieve a URL, PrintxPDF tries its own reader first. If that reader fails or takes too long, the tool may try public third-party readers, which can receive the URL. Do not paste private or confidential links. For sensitive content, use the paste option or a local file when available.

Use it when
Keep in mind

body.x: Check the PDF before you file it

Open the file and check the title, date, important links, images, and end of the article. Long pages can break in unexpected places. If the PDF is a record, keep its source URL and access date. For an image preview of a saved PDF, use [PDF to JPG](/tools/pdf-to-jpg); a JPG does not keep selectable text.

faqs.q: How do I save an article without ads?
faqs.a: Paste a public URL into Web Page Cleaner, review the clean page, then use your browser’s Print option and choose Save as PDF. Open the downloaded file before sharing it.

faqs.q: Does Web Page Cleaner work with every website?
faqs.a: Not always. Some sites block readers, require a login, or load article text with scripts. If the URL does not work, try pasting the text or HTML, or use your browser’s print feature.

faqs.q: Does the URL I paste stay only on my device?
faqs.a: Not necessarily. PrintxPDF tries its own reader first. If that fails or stalls, public third-party reader services may receive the URL. Avoid using private or confidential links.

faqs.q: Will the saved PDF still have ads?
faqs.a: The clean view removes many ads, menus, and other page clutter, but results depend on the website. Open the PDF and confirm the main article is complete.

posts.title: How to print a web receipt cleanly
posts.metaTitle: Print a web receipt without ads or menus
posts.metaDescription: Print a web receipt clearly and check amounts and dates. Free, no signup, no watermark. Choose the method that fits the receipt privacy.
posts.primaryKeyword: how to print a web receipt cleanly
posts.answer: To print a web receipt clearly, first use the store’s Download or Print option. If the receipt is a public page covered with menus or ads, open it in Web Page Cleaner and save the clean view as a PDF. Private pages behind a login may not load from a pasted URL. Check amounts, date, tax, and order number before filing the copy.

body.x: To print a web receipt without menus or ads, start with the store’s own download. If you only have a cluttered public page, [Web Page Cleaner](/print) can prepare a cleaner view to print or save as a PDF. Do not paste a private order URL: it may require a login, and the URL may reach public readers if PrintxPDF’s own reader fails.
How to print or save a web receipt as a PDF

items.x: On the order page, choose Download receipt, Invoice, or PDF when available. This preserves the document issued by the seller.
If no download is available, open the receipt and select Print. In the preview, choose Save as PDF and check that all items and totals appear.
For a cluttered public page, open [Web Page Cleaner](/print). Its remote reader cannot access pages that require authentication.
Verify the store name, order number, date, currency, subtotal, tax, and total.
Use a clear name such as store-date-receipt.pdf. Keep the confirmation email too if it is part of the record.

body.x: Protect receipt details

A receipt may show your name, address, part of a payment method, or order number. Before sending it, decide which details the recipient needs. If you need to combine receipts, check the order and use [Merge PDF](/tools/merge-pdf). Cleaning a page does not make the file private; control the PDF copy and how you send it.

faqs.q: What is the safest way to save a purchase receipt?
faqs.a: Download the official PDF from the store when available. If only a private page is available, print it from your browser while signed in and save the file locally. Check all amounts before filing it.

faqs.q: Can Web Page Cleaner open my receipt after I sign in?
faqs.a: Not necessarily. Its URL reader does not use your login session or cookies. Use the store’s download button or print the page already open in your browser.

faqs.q: Can I save the print preview as a PDF?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose Save as PDF in your browser’s print dialog. Check paper size, margins, pages, and totals before saving.

faqs.q: Should I remove personal details before sharing a receipt?
faqs.a: Share only the details the recipient needs. A receipt may include your name, address, or order information. If you must hide content, use true redaction and check the PDF before sending.

posts.title: How to print a recipe without ads
posts.metaTitle: Print a recipe without ads or extra photos
posts.metaDescription: Print recipes without ads and keep ingredients and steps. Free, no signup, no watermark. Review the page before you save it.
posts.primaryKeyword: how to print a recipe without ads
secondaryKeywords: remove clutter before printing a recipe
posts.answer: To print a recipe without ads, first use the website’s print button. If you only have a cluttered public page, Web Page Cleaner can remove menus and distractions before you print or save a PDF. Check ingredients, amounts, temperature, and steps because recipe sites may hide content in expandable sections. For private pages, print from your browser; do not paste login URLs.

body.x: A recipe page often includes a story, photos, and buttons you do not need while cooking. Look for “Print recipe” or “Jump to recipe” first. If those controls are missing on a public page, [Web Page Cleaner](/print) can create a cleaner view. Check that no ingredients or steps disappeared.
How to print a recipe without ads

items.x: Use “Print recipe” or “Jump to recipe” when the website provides them.
Choose Save as PDF for a digital copy and check the preview before saving.

items.h: Use Web Page Cleaner only when suitable
items.x: For a cluttered public page, open [Web Page Cleaner](/print). It cannot access pages that require a login.
Review ingredients, amounts, temperature, and every step before cooking or filing the copy.

body.x: Clean and print a web page. Free, no signup, no watermark.
Compare ways to print a recipe

head: Method
Use when
Limit
rows: A dedicated recipe layout is available
A public page has ads or menus
It does not keep your site login session.

body.x: Keep a useful, complete copy

A printed recipe should keep units, servings, substitutions, and oven temperature. If you do not need photos, adjust browser print settings; the cleaner does not select each image precisely. Save pages only for permitted use. Do not paste private links or share account details.

faqs.q: How do I print a recipe without ads?
faqs.a: Look for the website’s print button first. For a cluttered public page, use Web Page Cleaner and check that all ingredients and steps remain before printing or saving as PDF.

faqs.q: Does Web Page Cleaner remove recipe photos?
faqs.a: It removes many page elements, such as menus and distractions, but does not choose each image precisely. Review the result and use browser print settings if you want to omit specific photos.

faqs.q: Can I save a recipe as a PDF?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose Save as PDF in your browser’s print preview. Check amounts, units, and every step in the final file.

faqs.q: Can I paste a private recipe URL?
faqs.a: No. The remote reader does not use your cookies, and a failed fetch may send the URL to public readers. Print the page already open or paste a copy of its content.
